description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'Loader', which displays animated circles as a loading indicator. The component manages its internal state for fade-in/fade-out transitions and uses hooks to initiate animation.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component serving as a loading indicator with animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates an interval that toggles the alpha value between 0 and 1 to animate the loading circles.
